entities.title: zazzle-csharp-minifier source
entities.summary: The zazzle-csharp-minifier project in one flat folder (namespace ZazzleMinifier): the command line, the four rewriting commands, identifier listing and renaming, the shared plan and layout helpers, and the repository setup.
entities.purpose: Builds the single zazzle-csharp-minifier executable (zazzle-csharp-minifier.csproj). Program.cs parses the switches with Cli.Parse and hands them to Runner.Run, which runs each requested command (StripComments, SplitTests, SplitHeaders, Restructure, Rename) as a Plan of in-memory edits with Changes, Notes and Errors, applies or, with --check, only reports them, and then calls RepoSetup to give the repository the skill, an AGENTS.md section and a pre-commit block. Identifiers prints the identifier tree that Rename reads back.
boundaries: The tests are in macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-minifier/tests/, which reaches the internal types through InternalsVisibleTo.
Build settings shared with the tests (target framework, version) are in macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-minifier/Directory.Build.props.
The skill text it writes into repositories is agents/skills/zazzle-csharp-minifier/SKILL.md, embedded at build time; change it there.

C# is parsed, bound and renamed with Roslyn (Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp and its Workspaces package); compile checks use the .NET 8 reference assemblies package, so nothing is loaded from the machine's .NET.
It starts git during repository setup, and for --benchmark also cp, rm, git and the claude CLI (Proc.RunWithInput), never through a shell.
